name: L4 · 你穿红色的很好看
titleEn: You look pretty good in red

title.en: At the entrance of the mall

intro.cn: 在商场门口，王一雪和刘小雪在聊天儿。
intro.en: At the entrance of the shopping mall, Wang Yixue and Liu Xiaoxue were chatting.

questions.q: 王一雪和刘小雪要去哪儿看看？
刘小雪为什么要进去看看？

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 妈妈，我们来过这家商场吗？
lines.en: Mom, have we been to this shopping mall before?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 没来过，这是新开的。
lines.en: No, it just opened recently.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 我们进去看看吧。
lines.en: Let's go inside and have a look.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 好啊！你想买点儿什么？
lines.en: Sure! What do you want to buy?

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 我想买条裤子。
lines.en: I want to buy a pair of pants.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 没问题。
lines.en: No problem.

postQuestions.q: 王一雪和刘小雪来过这家商场吗？

words.en: used after a verb to indicate a past action or state
measure word for long, narrow, or thin things

intro.cn: 在商场，王一雪和刘小雪在看衣服。
intro.en: In the shopping mall, Wang Yixue and Liu Xiaoxue were shopping for clothes.

questions.q: 王一雪让刘小雪试试什么？

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 妈妈，我想买这条白色的裤子。
lines.en: Mom, I want to buy this pair of white pants.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 你有很多白色的衣服，为什么还买白色的？
lines.en: You already have lots of white clothes. Why do you want to buy something white again?

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 因为我喜欢白色啊！
lines.en: Because I like white!

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 我觉得这条白色的不太好看，你试试那条红色的吧。
lines.en: I don't think this white one looks very good. Why don't you try that red one instead?

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 我没穿过红色的，红色的好看吗？
lines.en: I've never worn red before. Do you think red looks good on me?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 就是因为没穿过，所以要试试啊！
lines.en: That's exactly why you should give it a try!

postQuestions.q: 王一雪觉得白色的裤子好看吗？
刘小雪穿过红色的裤子吗？

intro.cn: 在商场，王一雪和刘小雪在看书包。
intro.en: In the shopping mall, Wang Yixue and Liu Xiaoxue were shopping for schoolbags.

questions.q: 王一雪和刘小雪觉得哪个好看？

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 妈妈，我想买个新书包。
lines.en: Mom, I want to buy a new schoolbag.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 好，那边卖书包，我们过去看看吧。
lines.en: Okay. They're selling schoolbags over there. Let's go and take a look.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 这么多漂亮的书包！
lines.en: There are so many beautiful ones!

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 红色的、绿色的、黑色的，你想买哪个？
lines.en: Red ones, green ones, black ones—which one do you want?

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 绿色的吧。
lines.en: The green one.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 不错，我也觉得绿色的更好看。
lines.en: Not bad. I think the green one looks better too.

title.en: Writing a diary in the room

intro.cn: 在房间，刘小雪在写日记。
intro.en: In the room, Liu Xiaoxue was writing in her diary.

questions.q: 判断正误：商场里的东西不便宜。
判断正误：刘小雪穿红色的裤子很好看。

lines.cn: 我和妈妈去了一家商场。因为是新开的，所以这几天东西很便宜。
lines.en: I went to a shopping mall with my mom. Since the mall had just opened, the prices were quite affordable these days.

lines.cn: 商场里的衣服颜色很多。我没穿过红色的裤子，妈妈让我试了试，我觉得我穿红色的也很好看。
lines.en: The clothes there came in many different colors. I had never worn red pants before, and my mom encouraged me to give them a try. I thought I looked pretty good in red too.

grammar.note: 动态助词“过”用在动词后面，表示动作曾在过去发生，但未持续到现在。基本结构：主语＋动词＋过＋宾语。否定形式是在动词前面加“没（有）”。疑问形式有三种：句尾加“吗”；句尾加“没有”；动词＋没＋动词＋过。
grammar.noteEn: The aspect particle “过” is used after a verb to indicate that an action occurred in the past but has not continued to the present. Basic structure: Subject + Verb + 过 + Object. The negative form is constructed by adding “没（有）” before the verb. There are three interrogative forms: add “吗” at the end; add “没有” at the end; or Verb + 没 + Verb + 过.

items.en: She has never been to China.
Have we been to this shopping mall before?
Has Chen Tianzhong ever eaten dumplings?
Have you seen that movie or not?

practice.cn: A：今天晚上我想看个电影。 B：这个电影不错，____，你也看看吧。
A：这家超市的苹果好吃吗？ B：____，我也不知道。

grammar.note: “因为……所以……”构成因果关系复句。“因为”和“所以”可以成对使用，也可以只用其中的一个。
grammar.noteEn: The structure “因为……所以……” forms a complex sentence expressing cause and effect. “因为” and “所以” can be used either together as a pair or individually.

items.c: 就是因为没穿过，所以要试试啊！
items.en: That's exactly why you should give it a try!

items.c: 因为我生病了，今天没去上班。
items.en: Because I was sick, I didn't go to work today.

items.c: 我没去过他家，所以让他来车站接我。
items.en: I've never been to his home, so I asked him to pick me up at the station.

practice.cn: A：你今天回来这么早啊！ B：____
A：你为什么想去西安旅游？ B：____
A：天气这么好，你为什么不去外边玩玩？ B：____

grammar.note: 结构助词“的”用在名词、代词、动词、形容词等后面，组成“的”字短语，相当于名词性短语。
grammar.noteEn: The structural particle “的” is used after nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives, etc., to form a “的” phrase, which functions as a noun phrase.

items.c: 红色的、绿色的、黑色的，你想买哪个？
items.en: Red ones, green ones, black ones—which one do you want to buy?

items.c: 这个面包是爸爸买的，妈妈买的在那儿。
items.en: This bread was bought by Dad; the one Mom bought is over there.

items.c: 这件衣服太贵了，还是买那件便宜的吧。
items.en: This piece of clothing is too expensive; let's buy that cheaper one instead.

A：小明，来吃个苹果吧。你吃哪个？ B：我要这个____。
A：今天的饭菜是爸爸做的，好吃吗？ B：好吃，但我更喜欢吃妈妈____。

items.cn: 我看见老师在教室里，你____找她吧。
你已经有一____黑色的裤子了，别买了。
我来过这家____，它是今年一月新开的。
A：妈妈，你看见我的____了吗？ B：没看见，你再找找吧。
A：你想买件什么____的衣服？ B：我喜欢绿色，买绿色的吧。

classroomActivity.description: 两人一组，一人扮演售货员，一人扮演顾客。顾客想买裤子，询问裤子的颜色、大小和价钱，等等。尽可能使用本课所学生词和语法。
classroomActivity.descriptionEn: Work in pairs. One student plays the salesperson and the other plays the customer. The customer wants to buy a pair of pants and asks about the colors, sizes, prices, and other details. Try to use the vocabulary and grammar learned in this lesson as much as possible.
